caddyfile.title: Challenge 1: Caddyfile → SML
caddyfile.prompt: Below is a Caddyfile. Please use SML to express equivalent configuration: Change the site block to a nested block, and change key value to key: value. After completion, click 'Verify' and the system will check if all key fields are translated correctly. The verification logic is JS directly parsing your SML and asserting the result.
caddyfile.hint: `example.com { }` block of Caddyfile==`example.com { }` nested block of SML; `tls internal` == `tls: internal`。

docker-compose.title: Challenge 2: Docker-compose.yml → SML (High Difficulty)
docker-compose.prompt: Translate the docker compose fragment below into SML. Note that the array [a, b] of : YAML is written as [ a b ] in SML; The key names with hyphens (such as container_name) can be directly used as bare word keys. Verification will check the key fields of services.web and services.db.
docker-compose.source:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret
docker-compose.hint: The hyphens `-` and underscores `_` in SML bare words are legal key characters, so container_name/POSTGRES-PASSWORD does not use quotation marks.

nginx.title: Challenge 3: nginx.conf → SML (High Difficulty)
nginx.prompt: Translate the nginx server block below into SML. Nginx's listen 80; == SML listen: 80； location/{ } are nested blocks; proxy_pass http://app; is a value with spaces and requires quotation marks. Verify the key instructions for checking the server block.
nginx.hint: The value of proxy passed contains spaces and colons, and must be enclosed in quotation marks: `proxy_pass: "http://app:3000"`. But the example.com of `server_name example.com` can be bare words.
